title: Kubernetes & Orchestration
intro: Kubernetes interview questions are now standard for any senior Java backend role — pods, deployments, services, ingress, ConfigMaps and Secrets, HPA and resource requests/limits, StatefulSets and persistent volumes, rolling updates and rollback, network policies, RBAC, and the production-debugging questions interviewers ask ("a pod is in CrashLoopBackOff — walk me through your debug"). Pair this page with the Docker, CI/CD and Cloud-Native pages for the full container-platform interview surface.
